about.title: A film plant in Hefei, shipping to converters worldwide
about.subtitle: Anhui Eastern Communication Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd. has manufactured and exported packaging film since 2014.
story: AEC Group started in 2014 with a simple observation: packaging converters were buying film through layers of traders, and every layer added cost, delay and a slightly different answer about what was actually on the roll.

So we built the other way round. Our plant in the Baohe Industrial District of Hefei runs BOPP, BOPET, BOPS, CPP and POF lines, with slitting, metallizing, coating and printing under the same roof. When a buyer asks for 18 µm at 640 mm with a 3-inch core and corona treatment on one side, the answer comes from the people setting the line — not from a sales office three time zones away.

Twelve years on, we ship more than 10,000 tonnes a year to converters, printers and tape makers in more than 50 countries. What has not changed is the working method: a written specification before production, a sample before the container, and a named contact who answers while the order is running.

faq.title: MOQ, lead time, samples and paperwork
faq.subtitle: The five questions every new buyer asks — answered plainly, before you send an inquiry.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
items.a: MOQ depends on the grade and the width you need: stock grades can ship from a single jumbo roll, while custom metallized, coated or printed runs are quoted per order. Tell us the film, thickness, width and monthly volume and we will state the exact minimum in your quotation.

items.q: How long does production and delivery take?
items.a: Stock grades are typically ready to load within 7–15 days of deposit; custom slitting, metallizing or printing usually takes longer and is confirmed in writing on the proforma invoice. Ocean transit then depends on your port — we quote both FOB and CIF so you can compare.

items.q: Can I get samples before ordering?
items.a: Yes. A4 sheets and roll samples of stock grades are free; you cover the courier if you prefer your own account. Samples usually leave Hefei within a few working days, and we can match a sample you send us.

items.q: Which certifications and documents come with the film?
items.a: The plant works to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, and our films are supplied with FDA, SGS, RoHS and REACH documentation as applicable to the grade. Certificates, MSDS, packing list and certificate of origin are prepared with the shipping documents.

items.q: What are your payment and shipping terms?
items.a: T/T and L/C at sight are both accepted, with the exact terms written on the proforma invoice. We ship FOB from Chinese ports or CIF to yours, and can arrange pallet specifications for your warehouse.

items.q: Can you produce to our own specification or brand?
items.a: Yes — that is most of what we do. Width, thickness, core, winding direction, treatment, metallizing and printing are set per order, and OEM/private-label cartons carry your brand and documentation.
